notes: Access: robots.txt has no full-site Disallow for Claude bots (only excludes /search/, account, cart, PDP-variant params etc.), so not a hard block. Tier 1 (curl_cffi, 14 browser-impersonation profiles) reached the homepage (200) but every /c/ category PLP returned DataDome's 403 JS-challenge (matches prior Home-Decor-pass notes for this company). Tier 2 headless Playwright hit a full DataDome CAPTCHA iframe (geo.captcha-delivery.com) on the same /c/ URL. Used Tier 3 Claude-in-Chrome (real browser session) as last resort, which loaded pages normally. Checked main nav mega-menus (BONS PLANS/GREAT DEALS, NOUVEAUTES/NEW PRODUCTS, PRODUITS, SECONDE CHANCE/SECOND CHANCE) and homepage embedded JSON (window.__INITIAL_STATE__ navigation tree) for 'best-seller'/'meilleures ventes' terms. Found one genuine Bestsellers node, 'Best-sellers du moment', which recurs identically as a shortcut link inside multiple category sub-menus in the mega-menu (same URL every time) -- confirmed as one canonical listing, not several. The pill filters shown on the PLP itself (Canapes et fauteuils, Deco, Luminaires, Meubles, Miroirs, Tables et chaises) are facet shortcuts within the same listing/URL, not separate site-defined sub-category PLPs, so only one row is emitted. Also found and EXCLUDED 'Jusqu'a -20% sur nos best-sellers chaises' (a temporary promotional discount campaign on a subset of best-seller chairs, framed by % off not by bestseller merchandising -- a Sale-type promo page, not a Bestsellers listing per se).
